title: geofm-landslide-benchmark: cross-model evaluation protocol and derived datasets for geospatial foundation models in landslide susceptibility
description: Reproducibility package for 'What survives an audit: evaluating geospatial foundation models for landslide susceptibility against a geomorphometric baseline' (in preparation for Earth Science Informatics). Includes the cross-FM benchmark with random-initialization ablation and point-probe controls (context-matched manual baselines, spectral scar probe, constrained-negative sensitivity, and a pre-/post-event composite test of scar leakage), the control arms (ground motion, movement typology, geology, climate), the audit re-analyses (positional floor on the benchmark folds for every pipeline, range of spatial dependence against the block size, variance of the negative draw and of the block-grid placement, readers tuned by nested spatial cross-validation), susceptibility surfaces validated with success- and prediction-rate curves on out-of-fold surfaces (the transformer-block sweep, low-rank adaptation and Prithvi surfaces predate the input-offset correction and are kept only for traceability), the table/figure generators, and the derived datasets: 17-layer geomorphometric feature stacks (npz) for five Chilean basins, Sentinel-2 L2A composites (GeoTIFF) built per MGRS tile, including a season-matched, radiometrically harmonized 2016/2023 pair for the pre-/post-event test, sampled benchmark points with spatial-block ids (CSV), and per-fold result files (JSON).
